query: ALTER TABLE audit_log_change ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_change_pkey PRIMARY KEY(audit_log_id, field), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_change_audit_log_id_fkey_audit_log_id FOREIGN KEY(audit_log_id) REFERENCES audit_log(id), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_change_chk_field_not_empty CHECK(field <> ''), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_change_old_new_value_not_both_null CHECK(NOT(old_value IS NULL AND new_value IS NULL));
